import sys
from collections import defaultdict

MOD = 1000000007
INV = 570000004

def add_mod(a, b):
    s = a + b
    return s - MOD if s >= MOD else s

def sub_mod(a, b):
    s = a - b
    return s + MOD if s < 0 else s

def mul_mod(a, b):
    return (a * b) % MOD

# Read input
input = sys.stdin.read().split()
n = int(input[0])
p_values = input[1:]
p = [[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
idx = 0
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        p[i][j] = int(p_values[idx])
        p[i][j] = mul_mod(p[i][j], INV)
        idx += 1

# Represent bitset as integer
def set_bit(n, pos):
    return n | (1 << pos)

def get_bit(n, pos):
    return (n >> pos) & 1

# Generate all subsets
total_nodes = 0
index_map = {}
child = []

def dfs(state):
    nonlocal total_nodes, index_map, child
    if state in index_map:
        return index_map[state]
    id = total_nodes
    total_nodes += 1
    index_map[state] = id
    child.append([0]*(1 << n))
    for mask in range(1 << n):
        new_state = state
        for j in range(n):
            if get_bit(new_state, j) == 0:
                k_mask = mask & ((1 << n) - 1)
                k = k_mask
                while k:
                    lsb = k & (-k)
                    j_xor = j ^ (lsb.bit_length() - 1)
                    if get_bit(state, j_xor):
                        new_state = set_bit(new_state, j)
                        break
                    k ^= lsb
        child[id][mask] = dfs(new_state)
    return id

# Initialize DFS
dfs(1 << 0)

# Precompute q
q = [[1]*(1 << n) for _ in range(n)]
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(1 << n):
        val = 1
        for k in range(n):
            bit = get_bit(j, k)
            if bit:
                val = mul_mod(val, p[k][i])
            else:
                val = mul_mod(val, sub_mod(1, p[k][i]))
        q[i][j] = val

# Initialize DP
dp = [[0]*(total_nodes) for _ in range(n+1)]
dp[0][0] = 1

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(total_nodes):
        if dp[i][j] != 0:
            for k in range(1 << n):
                next_state = child[j][k]
                dp[i+1][next_state] = add_mod(dp[i+1][next_state], mul_mod(dp[i][j], q[i][k]))

# Prepare result bitset
result_state = 0
for i in range(n):
    result_state = set_bit(result_state, i)

# Output the result
print(dp[n][index_map[result_state]])
